groups.name: Initial confirmation / Roadmap expansion confirmation
groups.guarantee: V2 commit uses one owned, current, sealed change-set transaction. Legacy materialization rejects adopted Plans.
groups.qualification: joint apply; duplicate receipt; five rollback boundaries

groups.name: Rebalance confirmation
groups.guarantee: Semantic diff and protected execution validate before any write; paused remaining overlays and withdrawal retain accepted history. Legacy rebalance rejects adopted Plans.
groups.qualification: semantic identity; KEPT stability; withdrawal/continuation; Focus race

groups.name: Plan shells, generation/expansion attempts, revisions and archive
groups.guarantee: Owned immutable intent/revision, durable request correspondence, fence/deadline/CAS and atomic publication. Archive supersedes work and preserves execution.
groups.qualification: intent/lease/cancellation/currentness; worker SIGKILL/SIGTERM; workspace

groups.name: Optional stretch promotion
groups.guarantee: Adopted Plan promotion cannot use the legacy service; authorized change must become a sealed proposal and canonical apply. No Phase 2 promotion intelligence is introduced.
groups.qualification: legacy mutation guard and current SQL guards

groups.name: Copilot generated-item release
groups.guarantee: Legacy Copilot cannot release adopted linked work. Canonical diff removes unstarted work or withdraws started work, retaining lineage.
groups.qualification: permanent tombstone; withdrawal/continuation

groups.name: Released-work reoffer accept/decline
groups.guarantee: Old reoffer cannot mutate adopted Plans. A new approved activity uses explicit lineage; removed identities cannot silently reattach.
groups.qualification: tombstone SQL and execution correspondence

groups.name: Manual linked Quest structural edit/delete escape hatch
groups.guarantee: Generic structural edits/deletes fail for adopted linked work; cosmetic Goal edits are separate. No manual-quest capability bypasses V2 SQL.
groups.qualification: actual old-client route rejection; SQL structural protection

groups.name: Manual linked Goal edit and guarded bulk Goal deletion
groups.guarantee: Linked outcome/deadline changes require canonical intent/review; delete rejects linked work. Canonical apply owns semantic Goal projection.
groups.qualification: Goal route units; owned Goal/deferred SQL; atomic apply

groups.name: Ordinary/manual or SubjectNode Quest creation
groups.guarantee: User coordination encloses final ownership/node/rest/timezone/reward reads and creation; adoption guards prevent introducing unversioned work into a V2 Goal.
groups.qualification: generic Quest vs apply capacity conflict; Quest creation units

groups.name: Ordinary field/status update and explicit completion
groups.guarantee: Linked explicit completion requires protocol/version and authoritative completion service. Client elapsed writes and withdrawn completion cannot bypass it.
groups.qualification: duplicate actual route completion; settlement/reward tests

groups.name: Single/bulk Quest deletion
groups.guarantee: Standalone deletion remains supported with fresh checks. Linked structural deletion requires review; started history cannot be deleted.
groups.qualification: old-client delete rejection; zero-second SQL protection

groups.name: Goal CRUD routes
groups.guarantee: Goal CRUD uses user coordination and fresh linked guards; ordinary Goals remain supported.
groups.qualification: Goal route units; generic SQL ownership/Goal guard

groups.name: Timeline adjustment endpoint
groups.guarantee: Ordinary timeline read/write/message is one transaction; adopted linked adjustment fails rather than running a second allocator.
groups.qualification: calendar/Goal units; adopted structural SQL guard

groups.name: Generic chat Goal/Quest create/update
groups.guarantee: Each mutation encloses consequential reads and writes in executionTransaction; providers remain outside. Linked commands require review.
groups.qualification: calendar-tools units; SQL source/Quest backstops

groups.name: Chat Goal/Quest destructive commands
groups.guarantee: Owned destructive authorization is retained; linked Goals/Quests fail closed.
groups.qualification: calendar-tools and Goal deletion units; SQL backstop

groups.name: Chat completion
groups.guarantee: Generic chat does not fabricate a V2 execution version. Linked completion requires the same canonical execution service/protocol as Focus.
groups.qualification: completion guards; withdrawal prohibition; calendar-tools units

groups.name: Move, swap, clear-day tools
groups.guarantee: Move/swap/clear-day decisions and writes share user coordination. Linked structural requests require a reviewed change, never legacy date math.
groups.qualification: calendar-tools units; independent Quest/source SQL rejection

groups.name: Start and lazy recovery API
groups.guarantee: Zero-second adopted starts and owned restore use RUNNING/PAUSED/ENDED and execution versions; user lock precedes Session/Quest.
groups.qualification: separate-connection start/apply; browser pause/reload; native fetch transport

groups.name: Heartbeat/finalize/complete API
groups.guarantee: Acknowledged transitions, cumulative clamp, durable receipt and server precedence retain epoch/leadership owners. End does not infer study completion.
groups.qualification: timing tolerance; response loss; stale device; browser END

groups.name: Weekly streak award after settlement
groups.guarantee: Existing weekly mission/economic math settles inside the same coordinated transaction exactly once.
groups.qualification: competing protocol mission settlement and rollback

groups.name: Focus Party timer state
groups.guarantee: Party timer rows are not StudySession state and cannot pause/end/complete ordinary study. Shared Focus execution still uses S01/S02.
groups.qualification: Focus party shared-client units; account cascade PostgreSQL

groups.name: Weekly schedule settings
groups.guarantee: Schedule writes and acceptance share user coordination. Consequential values stale proposals; goals/preferences are not capacity.
groups.qualification: study-schedule units; context currentness; generic route conflict

groups.name: Floating rest-day toggle and automatic shifting
groups.guarantee: Desired state is idempotent; no old automatic shifter moves sealed work. Rest context changes remain visible and require linked replan.
groups.qualification: duplicate desired rest-day route; rest/calendar units

groups.name: Deadline sweep
groups.guarantee: Per-user fresh status/economics are coordinated; adopted work is not blindly failed by an incompatible legacy sweep.
groups.qualification: deadline/unit coverage; Quest execution SQL guard

groups.name: Lazy daily-study penalty
groups.guarantee: Fresh actual effort and HP/ledger update run under user-first coordination; accepted historical civil dates are retained.
groups.qualification: calendar/penalty units; economic/source SQL protection

groups.name: Timezone changes/onboarding
groups.guarantee: Timezone/availability writes are coordinated; accepted session executionContext retains original actual date.
groups.qualification: onboarding units; context staleness; accepted-date/session tests

groups.name: Subject creation/onboarding
groups.guarantee: Owned Subject creation and academic context updates use user coordination; weak progression is not verified mastery.
groups.qualification: Subject/onboarding units; source SQL guard

groups.name: Subject metadata edit/archive/restore
groups.guarantee: Metadata/archive/restore uses fresh owned state and execution checks; no active history cascade.
groups.qualification: Subject lifecycle/edit/delete units; context SQL guards

groups.name: AI syllabus compilation
groups.guarantee: Provider runs outside locks; final transaction verifies source currentness before replacing nodes. Accepted tasks remain immutable.
groups.qualification: Subject tests; direct node/source SQL protection

groups.name: Apex, skills, achievements, shop and stat investments
groups.guarantee: Fresh achievement facts+claim+message and ORM economy use shared coordination. Effective shop/equip/skill/Apex RPCs acquire user coordination before economics; old unused reward bypass signatures are dropped.
groups.qualification: actual duplicate achievement route; direct SQL shop lock wait/math; reward/skill units; retired function catalog

groups.name: Reset progress
groups.guarantee: Reset blocks linked work/open timers rather than inventing replan erasure. Ordinary reset updates correlated mirrors/ledgers and OTP atomically.
groups.qualification: actual blocked OTP preservation and ordinary reset route

groups.name: Account deletion and FK cascades
groups.guarantee: Explicit erasure is one coordinated security/cascade transaction; deleted Attempt ownership fences workers. Historical party membership cascades are allowed only for erasure.
groups.qualification: actual account route and late worker rejection

groups.name: Development seed and QA script
groups.guarantee: Not a product execution pathway. Existing admin seed/QA tools were not run against hosted data; adopted SQL still rejects uncoordinated writes.
groups.qualification: source disposition, not hosted qualification

groups.name: Classic direct materializer
groups.guarantee: Classic rejects an adopted user before provider dispatch and again before its coordinated final write. It cannot materialize V2 work or act as a fallback; retirement remains Phase 5 supported-client cutover.
groups.qualification: Classic/current suites; SQL adopted Goal guard

groups.name: Focus Party membership and indirect timer termination
groups.guarantee: Party membership/termination has no ordinary StudySession write; account erasure is the explicit exception. Never infer study completion from social presence.
groups.qualification: Focus party unit suites and actual historical-party erasure

groups.name: Existing PostgreSQL verification-script writers
groups.guarantee: Old verification scripts are not release authority and were not executed against hosted data. Required V2 tests enforce random loopback DB name+identity marker and isolated credentials.
groups.qualification: harness identity/bootstrap/catalog/concurrency evidence

scope: Repository execution writers; no hosted catalog or external principal qualification.
coverageNote: Actual-route PostgreSQL tests are distinguished from unit/source plus database-backstop evidence; not every route is claimed to have a dedicated PostgreSQL race.
